messages:
Miguel (AE): Heads-up — exec escalation for BlueWave POC. CIO just pushed back: must have SOC2 evidence + an on‑prem option for sensitive data. Procurement also flagged a request for penalty language (3% revenue) and E5 enterprise pricing. We’re blocked on legal + pricing. Can we triage? :exclamation:
Priya (SE): Thanks. Tech note: we can spin a private VPC instance for the POC within 5 business days if infra approves. Need Tom or infra to confirm resource availability and whether we can offer a short-term dedicated pool for eval traffic. Also need clarity on data purge requirements after POC.
Emma (Security): I can provide our SOC2 Type II summary and penetration test report — will upload to the secure bucket by EOD. BlueWave sent a 120-question security questionnaire; can one of you confirm who owns answers for network/ops vs product behavior? I can take the ops/security ones.
Alice (Sales Manager): If procurement expects E5 pricing or >25% discount, we need VP signoff. Miguel, capture exact pricing ask and whether they expect commitment length (12/24/36 mo). We should also prep an exec-to-exec call this week.
Tom (CTO): Re: dedicated pool — engineering can provision a small dedicated cluster for the POC but we need a formal escalation to approve the capacity. I can greenlight up to 4xA100-equivalent for 30 days. Any deeper infra changes (on-prem appliance) will need a longer lead + infra/ops calendar slot. I'm happy to join the exec call to explain tradeoffs.
Miguel (AE): BlueWave wants a 6-month proof + option to convert to reserved capacity. Pricing ask: they pushed for a 35% list discount and a 3% SLA penalty clause. They will sign if we can provide on-prem deployment + SOC2 docs and a one-week turnaround on the security questionnaire.
LegalBot: FYI — procurement redlined our standard MSA with a penalty clause and unlimited indemnity in section 7. Uploaded proposed redlines to Legal queue: link https://redwood/legal/queues/bluewave-1749004800. Need GC review for deviation.
Emma (Security): Quick Q on the questionnaire: item 47 asks about key management in air-gapped deployments — do we have an on-prem KMS HSM integration guide I can share? If not, I can outline required responsibilities for the customer side.
Priya (SE): For provisioning, infra runbook snippet below (for internal reference):
```
# provision dedicated cluster (internal-only)
redwood-cli infra allocate --pool dedicated --size small --region us-east-1 --owner bluewave-poc
redwood-cli deploy model --version v2.1 --quantization bf16
```
I can run this as soon as infra approves. Also recommend we enable prefix caching for the POC to lower token spend.
Alice (Sales Manager): Next steps: 1) Miguel to schedule exec call (target: 48 hrs). 2) Emma to finish questionnaire ops answers (EOD). 3) Legal to review redlines (48 hrs). 4) Tom to confirm infra capacity and join call. I'll escalate to VP Sales if we need >30% discount or contract deviations. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: when you've acknowledged tasks.
